model.name: R19.38: Chat messages are scenario units with ownerIor and a doubly-linked list of next/prev message IORs.
model.description: Each chat Message MUST be a first-class scenario unit (ior:class:Message) with: ownerIor pointing to the sender User unit, model.nextMessage as an IOR to the next message in thread order, model.prevMessage as an IOR to the previous message. This forms a doubly-linked list of messages navigable in both directions. Messages are stored in the scenario index like every other unit — unique uuid, {ior, model, ownerIor} shape, traceable.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "make messages first place scenario units with clear ownerIor and a double linked list of ior to next and previous message"
model.crossRefNote: R19.37 (unknown drop → room chat) will write Message units per this spec. R19.1 (room is a scenario unit) establishes the {ior, model, ownerIor} shape that Message reuses. The doubly-linked list provides thread navigation without requiring a separate index.
